description: Register a container image as a deployable version of an application. The image must already be pushed to a registry that Edgegap can pull from. Resource units: 1024 cpu units = 1 vCPU; memory_mb must be at least 256 and at most double the cpu units. Set verify_image true on the first version so a bad image fails here rather than at deploy time. Avoid the "latest" docker tag — use a build ID so deployments are reproducible.

docker_tag.description: Image tag. Use a build ID, not "latest".

env.description: Environment variables injected into the container.

max_duration_minutes.description: Auto-stop after this many minutes. Keeps test deployments from running up cost.

memory_mb.description: Memory in MB. At most 2x cpu_units.

name.description: Version identifier, typically a build ID or timestamp.

ports.description: Ports to expose. At least one is required for players to connect.

protocol.description: UDP, TCP, WS, or HTTP. Most game servers use UDP.

to_check.description: Readiness check on this port. Default true.

verify_image.description: Verify Edgegap can pull the image before accepting the version.

name: edgegap_create_app_version
title: Create an application version
